doc: The painted icon set (docs/art/STYLE.md, UI). Each sheet is one image-generation prompt: `style` + the tiles in reading order. tools/ui/icon_prompts.py prints the prompt for a sheet; the downloaded sheet goes to raw/ui_icons/<sheet>.png (gitignored); tools/ui/build_icons.py cuts it into assets/ui/icons/<name>.png. A tile's `look` is 'ghost' for an empty-slot glyph (dimmed, desaturated). A tile whose name starts with '_' is not written (a retired or spare painting). To add an icon: add a tile to a new sheet, generate, build.
style: Game inventory icon sheet: a {cols}x{rows} grid of {n} equal square tiles on one plain flat very dark charcoal-brown background, each tile holds one single object, centred, the whole object visible with a clear margin, three-quarter view, the same soft warm key light from upper left and a faint cool rim light on every tile. Hand-painted gouache and oil illustration with visible brushwork, painterly realistic northern folk craft, hand-adzed timber, dry-stone, wool and felt, black wrought iron with a rust bloom, horn and soapstone, weathered and lived-in, muted earthy palette. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no runes, no borders, no frames, no people, no faces. Tiles in reading order, left to right, top to bottom:
